title: Host setup configuration
statement: Given Boolean-alphabet machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$, a state $q$ of type $S$, an input $x\in\{0,1\}^*$, an input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ allowed positions, and Boolean strings $u,w$, define a configuration of the host machine on input $x$ with state $q$ and input-head position $p$. The tape indexed by the designated word-tape index $0$ stores $u$, the final work tape stores $w$, and every other work tape is blank.
